d:
The Raptors defeated the Pistons, 105-102 tonight in Detroit. Scottie Barnes contributed a team-high 29 points to go with 5 rebounds and 5 assists, with Allen Graves of the Raptors adding an additional 20 points (6-9 FG, 2-4 3P) in the game. Cade Cunningham finished with a team-high 23 points along with 9 assists for the Pistons in the losing effort. The Raptors improve their record to 6-10 with the win, while the Pistons fall to 10-5 for the season.
